title: Mindent egybevetve (Putting It All Together)
grammar: Pragmatic Discourse Particles (ugyebár, elvégre) & Conversational Transitions

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can use conversational discourse particles like ugyebár and elvégre.
I can make natural conversational shifts with apropó and erről jut eszembe.
I can use four words for independence, fluency, vocabulary and confidence.
I can say that a rich vocabulary gives a speaker confidence.
